title: The bird on the motel sill
logline: The bird on the motel's outside sill at 4 AM, looking in through the glass at the desk. The clerk not drawn. The bird's colors the only colors in a page of sodium orange.

panels.composition: The motel's front window from inside the lobby at 4 AM: sodium light on the lot, and on the outside sill, the rainbow bird, looking in. The glass between. The desk's edge at the bottom, nobody at it.

characters.pose: on the outer sill, looking in

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a motel lobby window at 4 AM with orange sodium light outside and a small brilliantly colored bird perched on the outer sill looking in through the glass, the edge of an empty desk at the bottom, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: The bird at the motel. Looking in.
